'''Scorched Sand''' (Japanese: {{hl|焼けた砂|Yaketa suna}} ''Scorched Sands'') is the fifteenth chapter of {{FE8}}.

==Plot==
{{main|Scorched Sand/Script (Eirika)|Scorched Sand/Script (Ephraim)}}

[[Eirika]] withstands attacks from two armies of [[Grado]]—lead by [[Caellach]] and [[Valter]]—as [[Ephraim]] rushes to her aid. [[Seth]] informs Eirika or Ephraim of the struggles the desert provides them. In Eirika's route, [[Riev]] teleports to Valter and speaks to him; Riev encourages Valter's "beastly" nature, and reiterates that he only needs to collect her bracelet. In Ephraim's route, [[Lyon]] speaks to Caellach; Lyon informs Caellach that Eirika and Ephraim are old friends of his, and Caellach shares that he has an old friend named [[Joshua]] from his time as a mercenary—Caellach states that he prefers his time as a Grado general and assures Lyon that he will win the battle, and Lyon leaves him to it.

During the battle, numerous characters can reconnect from being on opposite fronts of the conflict, including [[Tana]] and [[Innes]], [[Cormag]] and [[Duessel]], and Eirika and Ephraim.

Once the Grado armies are routed, Eirika and Ephraim reunite; they are both glad to see the other safe, and [[L'Arachel]] suggests they each share all the information they've gathered. Ephraim informs Eirika, L'Arachel, and [[Innes]] that Vigarde is dead and Grado is defeated; however, he also shares that the [[Dark Stone (object)|Dark Stone]], the catalyst for the war, is still at play, controlled by Lyon. Eirika cannot believe Lyon would instigate the war, based on her brief encounter with him in Jehanna; however, Ephraim's encounter with Lyon in Grado made him appear to be the mastermind of the war, and to have been corrupted by the Dark Stone. L'Arachel suggests they counteract the Dark Stone with the two remaining Sacred Stones, and the group decides to return to [[Renais]].

If [[Saleh]] is alive, he reunites with [[Myrrh]]; Myrrh apologizes for making him worry but Saleh apologizes for failing to protect her, and Saleh assures her that he intends to protect her for the remainder of his mission.

==Strategy==
{{strategy}}
As with all desert chapters, deploying magical units and fliers are going to be extremely helpful in completing the chapter.

The opening of this map differs by the chosen route, but on both, the main pressure is getting the other lord’s party to safety before they are overwhelmed by the aggressive enemies. (In the Japanese version this includes [[Caellach]], who is stationary in international releases). Status staffs are present on this mission, so bring [[Restore]] staves and manipulate deployment order to place the units you prefer be targeted at the bottom of the unit list. 

On [[Ephraim]]’s route, [[Eirika]]’s group must be brought to the main party, or have additional fighters brought to them while keeping the main group from being overwhelmed by the aggressive forces to the south. If the [[Archer]]s near the start are cleared, fliers can serve as taxis to place a strong unit in the fray before the area becomes dangerous. Despite [[Seth]]’s claims in the intro, Cavalry still remain quite effective on this level, as the initial attack on the southern front and the turn 8 reinforcements occur on a large swath of grass tiles. Powerful mounted units like [[Duessel]], any of the other Cavaliers if they've been promoted, or [[Mage Knight]] [[Lute]] should still be deployed.

When engaging [[Valter]], be wary of his [[Pierce]] skill. The 13% chance to ignore defense (and [[Glitch#Pierce glitch|potentially crash the game]]) is not listed on the battle summary or negated by supports. As such, caution should be taken when engaging him. 

While both bosses will drop their item upon death, they can still be stolen. If you recruited [[Rennac]] last chapter, he has enough speed at base to steal both boss's items on normal mode, even with the Japanese version's speed reduction, especially since Valter also has a speed reduction there. This allows critical and effective weaponry to be used against them. If aiming to get all the treasure, getting the [[Warp]] staff if Caellach is the last enemy left standing is a simple matter of rescuing the unit who obtains it.

==Trivia==
* This chapter contains the only obtainable [[Sleep (staff)|Sleep staff]] in [[Eirika]]'s route of {{title|The Sacred Stones}}, though actually getting it requires that the troubadour breaks her [[Mend]] staff, which is quite difficult.
** This chapter also contains the only obtainable [[Berserk (staff)|Berserk staff]] in [[Ephraim]]'s route of {{title|The Sacred Stones}}, and also requires that the troubadour breaks her [[Mend]] staff.
** The above two issues are only present in the localized version, as in the Japanese version the status-inflicting staves are the only thing present in those unit's inventories.
